70010000132613.description:
You enter an abandoned school hoping to uncover the truth behind its mysterious closure. Empty classrooms, silent hallways, and forgotten lockers hide clues to what really happened.

But before you can leave, the doors lock behind you.

Now your only goal is to escape. Explore the school, collect keys and uncover the dark secrets hidden within its walls. Just don't ignore the feeling that you're being watched.

Features:
>Explore a creepy abandoned school.
>Uncover the mystery behind the school's past.
>Experience atmospheric first-person horror.
>Evade the spirits that haunt the halls.
70010000132613.name: Missed Class: Horror

70010000133704.description:
Make your way through an icy obstacle course filled with slippery platforms, long jumps and freezing hazards. Stay focused as you leap across floating platforms and avoid falling into the frozen abyss.

Want a real challenge? Try Hardcore Mode, where every checkpoint is disabled. One slip, and it's back to the beginning.

FEATURES:
>Complete challenging ice-themed parkour levels.
>Jump across floating platforms and frozen terrain.
>Use checkpoints to save your progress.
>Take on Hardcore Mode with no checkpoints.
70010000133704.intro: Can you escape the frozen course?
70010000133704.name: Parkour Obby: Ice Escape

70010000128671.description:
Scritchy Scratchy is a super-satisfying scratch card incremental game where luck is your weapon, and glittering riches are just a scratch away.

Dive into a growing collection of scratchers, each with its own quirks, surprises, and sometimes downsides. Rip through tickets, uncover rare symbols, tweak your own luck, and chase absurd payouts.

Unlock Scratch Bot, your tireless mechanical friend who scratches and reveals the rewards for you. Turn your run into a full-blown jackpot engine as your balance shoots through the roof while you sit back and relax.

As you prosper, you’ll unlock upgrades that twist luck in your favor:

• Boosted odds and payouts
• Faster and easier scratching 
• New scratch card variants with unique rules

But power always comes with risk. Some cards tempt you with monstrous payouts at the cost of nasty penalties. Some offer steady income… others threaten your entire run. Will you play like a sensible adult or gamble like a degenerate in a neon casino?

When you’re ready for even more madness, Prestige to reset your run, gather Jack Points, and spend them on permanent upgrades that reshape your strategy. Build your own luck engine: Slow and steady, wildly explosive, or pure chaos.

Scritchy Scratchy is a dangerously satisfying progression casino, where every scratch is a little dopamine hit, and every run is one lucky break away from the big jackpot!
70010000128671.intro: Scritchy Scratchy is a super-satisfying scratch card incremental game. Buy stacks of scratch-offs, unlock auto-scratching, and chase massive jackpots. Will you play it safe or go all-in?
70010000128671.name: Scritchy Scratchy

70010000067527.description: Drop the pickaxe, grab a sword, and charge into a thrilling new adventure in Minecraft Dungeons II. Journey through unexplored lands and mysterious locations, in a quest to stop a new evil from causing chaos in not one, but two worlds! Clash with menacing foes in explosive encounters and fight your way through hordes of mobs that will do everything in their power to stop you from saving the day.
70010000067527.intro: Minecraft Dungeons II arrives on September 29!
70010000067527.name: Minecraft Dungeons II

70010000126615.description:
A Wholesomevania game

The Merlies, a community of tiny birds, got scattered across the land by a huge storm! Explore a colorful charming 2D universe and unlock new hidden passages as your Merlies squad grows and learns new skills, in a metroidvania-like gameplay. Use each Merlies’ specific abilities during your exploration in this poetic adventure game. 

While being beautiful, the world of The Merlies isn’t the most welcoming one. Your Merlies remain fragile little fellows exposed to the dangers of Nature. No creature or fight will be on your way but every thorn, every rock, every tree becomes an obstacle to overcome. Sometimes, the path will be hard to find, hidden in this wild and bucolic maze. And be careful not to lose one of your Merlies on the way!

Throughout your exploration, you’ll encounter remains of a long gone civilization. Lucky you! For one man’s junk is a Merlies’ treasure! Collect scraps to create and decorate your village, accommodate your Merlies and train them to get ready for exploration!

A great adventure in a small universe

Visually inspired by graphic novels and children’s image books, The Merlies is a bright and cozy tale. Befriend cute expressive birds and go out with your new friends to discover the many biomes and uncover their passageways and secrets.

Climb electric cables and fallen billboards, send your Merlies up in the sky by jumping on mushrooms or explore empty pipes. For your small Merlies, everyday objects take on gigantic proportions and get a new purpose for your community: make a cozy house out of a lamp, a huge map out of a slate or a store room out of an ice cube tray!
But their little size isn’t going to stop their adventurous and creative minds to create a new and better community for their kind.

A tale of resilience

Human civilization is gone and Nature is healing. Discover a calm and comforting adventure and help your community grow through recycling and upcycling human junk. Wacky constructions and clever upcycling are the key to bringing comfort and happiness to your tribe. The Merlies’ way of life is to do a lot, with a little.

The Merlies is a Solarpunk game: post-apocalyptic, sure, but not like you would expect. It’s a bright tale promoting a hopeful future, where your Merlies are brought together by cooperation and solidarity. Community spirit and a clever (re)use of scraps are key features that take the game far from dystopic Cyberpunk often associated with post-apocalypse. 

Features

An exploration-based poetic adventure
A “wholesomevania” gameplay: explore a 2D map at your own pace 
Exploit the many abilities of a squad of Merlies
Stunning and refined visuals with hand-made drawings
A solarpunk optimistic take on post-apocalypse games

Based on an idea by Cosmografik, creator of Type:Rider and Vandals.
70010000126615.intro: Meet the Merlies, adorable little birds scattered by the wind. Gather them together and recycle the trash to make a cozy nest.
70010000126615.name: The Merlies

70070000036346.description: Drop the pickaxe, grab a sword and charge into a thrilling new adventure in the Minecraft Dungeons II Deluxe Edition, featuring unique cosmetics, pre-order cosmetics and DLC 1+2 (when released)! Journey through unexplored lands in a quest to stop a new evil from causing chaos in not one, but two worlds. The challenges will be tougher than ever, so face them solo or with up to 4 players in online or couch co-op. With a crisis upon us, will you and your friends rise to meet it?
70070000036346.intro: Minecraft Dungeons II arrives on 29 September!
70070000036346.name: Minecraft Dungeons II - Deluxe Edition

70010000100940.description:
Kong: Survivor Instinct is a 2.5D action-adventure game that combines realistic platforming, challenging combat, and metroidvania-style exploration during a thrilling quest of survival worthy of the Monsterverse franchise.

TRUE MONSTERVERSE ADVENTURE
A sudden Titan attack prompts massive evacuation efforts-but not everyone makes it to safety before the devastation ensues. Caught in the crossfire between battling monsters, many residents become trapped in the collapsing city—your only daughter among them!

Influence the Titans with Monarch tech and use their enormous strength to your advantage as you navigate a treacherous maze of collapsing buildings, toxic leaks, and raging fires. Scavenge for resources, weapons, and tools to solve environmental puzzles and defend yourself against both human and monster enemies.

FACE THE LEGENDARY KONG 
Explore and survive as you encounter Kong in all his majestic glory, face the formidable Abaddon, and confront other new and returning superspecies and Titans! Whether you scavenge through half-destroyed buildings or fight off mercenaries, these enormous monsters are nearby, directly or indirectly impacting your gameplay. Though the Titans pose a lethal threat, you can - and must - influence their behavior with the ORCA Σ, a new prototype inspired by Monarch’s technology.

ALAN JONAH RETURNS
Discover an official Monsterverse story set shortly after the events of Godzilla vs. Kong. Stand your ground against the Hyenas, a mercenary group led by Alan Jonah. Reemerging after the events of Godzilla: King of the Monsters, the former eco-terrorist leader returns in Kong: Survivor Instinct with a new villainous scheme.

A FATHER’S MISSION TO RESCUE HIS DAUGHTER
Take on the role of David, an oil rig worker braving a crumbling city to find your only child, Stacy. Make your way through the districts while encountering fellow survivors taking shelter among the rubble, mourning their loved ones or on the verge of giving up hope. Feel the awe-inspiring terror Titans bring upon a city  through the eyes of a father desperate to find his daughter!
70010000100940.intro: Survive the wonder and terror of the Titans in this official Monsterverse game.
70010000100940.name: Kong: Survivor Instinct

70050000046471.description: The Painted Red Crime Scene includes a Location, 6 Suspects, 4 Customisation Items, and 6 Tokens
70050000046471.name: Cluedo - Painted Red

70010000119771.description:
In this unique survival horror game, classical music intertwines with psychological terror to create an oppressive, chilling atmosphere. You play Alice, an ordinary girl who wakes up to find herself trapped in a bizarre, ever-changing world. A snowbound orphanage, monsters lurking in the shadows, and intricate puzzles—every step is fraught with danger and uncertainty.

To survive, you must gather supplies, evade pursuit, and uncover the secrets hidden in the darkness. But as the truth gradually comes to light, can you bear the cruel reality behind it all?

Gameplay features:
Action Shooting
Use a variety of firearms to defeat enemies

Map Exploration
Explore the eerie orphanage step by step, collecting items to unlock new areas while confronting unexplained changes that may occur without warning

Resource Management
Gather and make prudent use of limited resources, and do whatever it takes to survive

Puzzle Solving
Gather clues, solve a wide range of puzzles, and uncover the final truth
70010000119771.intro: A nightmare you cannot wake from, a pain that refuses to fade.
70010000119771.name: SEEK

70010000128470.description:
Down Pit is a relaxed mining platform game set across many off-world underground locations. You are a cuboid mining unit with a singular skill set sent out to extract ore from strange underground places.

Dig.
Get Paid.
Upgrade.
Relax, maybe.
Collect.
Go Back Down Pit.
Dig.

Find your favourite location and dig all the ore. Return to Ore Processing and get paid.  All the pit locations from The Depot can be remined infinitely, for free - no unlocks, bail at any time with no penalty. Dig in your favourite mine again and again, and get paid.

Yes to Digging.
Yes to Getting Paid.

No to enemies, combat, secrets, story, unlocks, card games, skill trees, pets, fishing, timers, npc interruptions, never ending dialogue, walls of text, power of friendship, ancient evil force, lost parents, lost items, lost love, missing pets, self-asteem whining, neuroses listing, dot dot dotting, time wasting, anime, pixel art, anime inspired pixel art, faff.

Dig. And Get Paid.

There’s unlimited money to make with just you and all those mining areas to destroy, one block at a time. You arrive ready to mine, all equipment supplied, all ready to work. All the money is yours because only you will mine it out.

Teleport Down Pit is to the left (Dig).
Ore Processing is to the right (Get Paid).

Lots of other utilities are in The Depot but be careful not to get too distracted, some are costly, some will drain your time. Warning: the poker game does not work and never will (it is a long term programming issue caused by a fool).

Dig. And Get Paid.
70010000128470.name: Down Pit

70010000129849.description:
After the events of a shadow-beast invasion on a seaside town, complete villager quests and find hidden diaries to understand your role in this mysterious character-driven story.

SEASONS OF ILLISOR

From The Dancing Moon Inn to the Stoknel Swamp regions. Explore both hand-crafted and procedural zones with seasonal and weather effects, providing different moods as time progresses throughout the game.

UNRAVEL THE MYSTERY

Discover your role in this story as you complete a variety of quests and collect hidden diaries. Unravel the mystery of the missing teenagers and their entanglement between the tea-brewing Magisters and the frightening shadow-beasts!

MEET THE VILLAGERS

Learn more about Ïllisor and it’s villagers by doing activities like questing, crafting, farming, cooking, and fishing. Help rebuild the town from the recent invasion and get them back on their feet!

Will you discover your purpose in the world of Ïllisor and find a way back home? Track down those pesky teenagers? Or will you simply enjoy your time staying at The Dancing Moon?
70010000129849.intro: Tales from the Dancing Moon is a mystery adventure game inspired by British culture and portal-fantasy novels.
70010000129849.name: Tales from The Dancing Moon

70010000130717.description:
1. Hatch Eggs: Obtain juvenile monsters of random rarities
2. Raise Monsters: Wait for juvenile monsters to grow up
3. Sell Monsters: Sell monsters after they mature

70010000130717.intro: A relaxing idle monster collection game (with offline progress). Features 200 monster entries and 10 Lo-fi tracks.
70010000130717.name: Monster Nursery

70010000132993.description:
This pack includes the games: Rally Rock ´N Racing and Hypercar Racing.

Rally Rock ´N Racing

In Rally Rock 'N Racing, you’ll enjoy a wide variety of natural environments, such as deserts, snow-covered mountains, forests... where you can show your skill at the wheel, competing against everyone to become the fastest. The game has several modes, such as Championship, Time Trial, Arcade, and 4-player multiplayer.

Hypercar Racing

In Hypercar Racing you'll enjoy the dirtiest, fastest, and most spectacular races at speeds over 200 Mp/h, avoiding multiple collisions against 8 adversaries. The game has different modes, such as Championship, Arcade, and 4-player multiplayer.

Online leader board where you can compare your best times with those of your friends and players from around the world.

- Multi-player with 4 players.

 -Online ranking
70010000132993.intro: Enjoy 2 games in 1 with this irresistible speed games pack!
70010000132993.name: Rally & Hypercar Bundle

70010000133372.description:
You wake up in a dark hallway with no memory of how you got there. The exit is locked by an ancient curse, and the only way to break it is to find every cursed voodoo doll hidden throughout the endless corridors.

But something else roams the halls.

Features
>Explore eerie, cursed hallways.
>Collect voodoo dolls to lift the curse.
>Experience tense first-person horror.
>Survive a terrifying presence stalking the halls.
70010000133372.name: Screaming Halls: Horror

70010000090753.description:
Rainbow Island CS is a collection of several home ports of the arcade game Rainbow Islands.

　In addition to the popular 8 and 16-bit versions, the collection includes the never-released-on-cartridge MegaDrive/Genesis version. With 24 quick-save/load slots for each version and a feature that displays the location of the diamonds, there's never been a better time to experience it. It also includes a feature that lets you start the game in a powered-up state.

The PC Engine version is based on the NES version and features a main theme arranged for FM sound by Yukiharu Urita, as well as an ending theme composed by Norihiro Furukawa, both Zuntata (Taito's sound team) alumni.

What is Rainbow Islands?
Rainbow Islands is an arcade action game released by Taito in 1987 where the player controls Bubby or Bobby, using their rainbow magic as both weapons and platforms to climb and reach the goal at the highest point of each stage.

[Story] 
At the end of the previous game, Bubble Bobble, the bubble dragons Bub and Bob had rescued their parents and girlfriends and returned to their human forms of Bubby and Bobby.
Several years after those events, Bubby and Bobby return to their ancestral home, Rainbow Islands, in search of treasure, but end up entangled in another devious plot!
It seems that their true nemesis, the Boss of Shadow, has since resumed his evil machinations. Bubby and Bobby's path is blocked by various enemies, but with the “rainbow magic” given to them by their parents, they bravely continue their adventurous journey.

*The story described here is based on the Mega Drive and PC Engine versions. The content differs slightly in the Family Computer, Nintendo Entertainment System, and SEGA Master System versions.

Contents
・Rainbow Islands (Family Computer version) 
・Rainbow Islands (Nintendo Entertainment System version) 
・Rainbow Islands (Sega Master System version) 
・Rainbow Islands Extra (JP Mega Drive version) Rainbow Island Extra (US/EU Mega Drive/Genesis version) 
・Rainbow Islands (PC Engine CD-ROM² version)

*The background music for the Family Computer, Mega Drive, and PC Engine CD-ROM² versions uses the main theme based on the NES version.
70010000090753.intro: Experience 6 different versions of the magical world of Rainbow Islands! That comical place full of dreams is back!
70010000090753.name: Rainbow Islands CS

70010000099839.description:
■■ About the Game ■■

Heroic Songs: the Remix! is an Idol × City-Building Simulation Game where you help develop a land known as the Void while guiding the main heroine, Akari Sunohara, on her journey to become an idol. Build roads and facilities, attract new residents, and transform this desolate world into a vibrant Fanctuary worthy of the spotlight!

● A Diverse Lineup of Buildings
With over 50 unique buildings, you'll have plenty of ways to shape your city!
- Basic Facilities such as houses to attract Fans, and roads to connect your buildings
- Production Facilities, placed around resource tiles and visited by Fans to gather materials
- Processing Facilities, which convert one type of resource into another as a result of Fan visits
- Recreational Facilities, where resources are spent to generate Likes, a key progression resource
You can also earn Likes through Tours, or the rhythm-based Concerts described below.

● Idol Stages
By constructing personal stages, idols will perform for their Fans by singing and dancing in town! Idols with stages become available for Concerts and Tours, and will boost the surrounding buildings whenever they’re present. 

As idols gain experience from performances, their levels rise—enhancing those building effects even further! You can also assign skill points to customize how their influence spreads across your city. ;)

● Concerts
Concerts are short, 30-second rhythm games. Keep in time with the music to hit the target score and clear the stage! Successful Concerts will unlock new story content, boost idol and Fan experiences, and provide rewards. Some idols will also unlock alternate stage outfits as you progress through the game.

● A Wild Yet Heartfelt Story Unfolds!
Progress through successful concerts, construction projects, and city development to unlock new chapters in the story.
Follow Akari Sunohara—an ordinary girl with a love for idols—as she discovers her true calling. Dive deeper into each of the five main heroines in dedicated Character Stories, and experience each idol’s unique charm!

■ Characters ■
● Protagonist (You)
You’re the one who was transported to the Void alongside Akari. As the central figure in this world, your role is to support Akari and the other idols on their journey.

● Akari Sunohara / voiced by: Seika Hirose
An ordinary girl with an extraordinary love for idols. She possesses the innate potential to become one herself, and must step into the spotlight to find a way home.
At first, she struggles with doubt and frustration, but grows through her encounters with veteran idols and her fans in the fantasy worlds.

● Ruri Tsukuyomi / voiced by: Risae Matsuda
The Ultimate Idol, reigning at the top with an overwhelming presence and voice. Her legacy echoes throughout the various fantasy worlds Akari explores.

● Lynalelle Singulant / voiced by: Hitomi Sekine
The idol of Seven Falls, a fantasy-themed world. She’s a king, an idol, and a passionate idol superfan all in one!

● Haru / voiced by Yuka Amemiya
The idol of Discordia, a sci-fi-themed world. She’s a trusted senior to Akari, but seems to be hiding some complicated circumstances.

● Kaguya / voiced by Risae Matsuda
The idol of Karan Ashihara, a world with a traditional Japanese aesthetic. As the wild and fearsome Behemoth of Befoulment, she stands in Akari’s path as a powerful rival.
70010000099839.intro:
Build a Sanctuary for Idols Across Fantasy Worlds!
A City-Building × Idol Simulation Game
70010000099839.name: Heroic Songs: the Remix!

70010000117983.description:
Welcome to Sesame Street! A place to play, laugh and grow. 

From the moment you arrive, there’s so much to do. Join Elmo, Tango and the rest of your Sesame Street friends around the neighbourhood! 

Walk around with Grover, plant a magical giant beanstalk in Abby’s Garden, find useful tools and rubber ducks in the Community Garden with Bert & Ernie, and work on your number and puzzle skills in Count von Count’s Mansion. Or cook, mix and laugh along with Cookie Monster in his Foodie Truck! Some quests may take a few tries, but you’ll work together to find a way to make the streets a brighter and happier place for everyone. 

Make yourself at home! Decorate your house, unlock new mini-games, access exciting new areas of the Street, or throw and unforgettable block party. Spend time with Tango, your cheerful and furry helper or enjoy the whole adventure together with family and friends in local co-op play.  

The fun and exploration never ends on Sesame Street!  

JOIN THE NEIGHBORHOOD: Create your own character and join Elmo, Tango, Abby and their friends on Sesame Street.  

EXPLORE THE STREET: Start at your apartment, stop by Big Bird’s cozy nest, play at the Count’s Mansion, and unlock more places. 

BRING EVERYONE TOGETHER: Help the community by going on cooking, photography, and even farming quests solo or in co-op. 

DISCOVER AND GROW: Use rewards to decorate your home, unlock new mini-games and access exciting new areas. 

TRAVEL WITH TANGO: Take care of Tango just like she’ll take care of you as she helps you get around.  

THE STAGE IS YOURS: Choose from the colorful backdrops, lights, and other cool special effects for the main stage.
70010000117983.intro: Move in and feel right at home and celebrate with your Sesame Street friends.
70010000117983.name: Sesame Street: Friends & Fun

70010000122281.description:
The HORSE CLUB is visiting the Wild River Ranch!

Travel with your friends Hannah, Sofia, Sarah, and Lisa to the Wild West. Explore the vast landscape, help old and new friends, experience exciting adventures on horseback, learn Western riding, test your skills, and claim the crown at the big Western riding tournament!

Dive into a lovingly crafted world and explore the adventurous surroundings at your own pace.

Experience a charming, engaging story full of humor.

In addition to classic riding disciplines like barrel racing and pole bending, you can also test your skills in activities such as archery, painting, and playing the guitar.

Six unique horses are waiting to be ridden - each with its own character and traits that you can develop throughout the game.

Create your own style for you and your horse with numerous customization options and a wide selection of carefully designed color combinations.

All of this is accompanied by an atmospheric original soundtrack composed by Grammy®-winning musician Winifred Phillips.

From the creators of the HORSE CLUB Adventures series - Wild River Games

Based on the HORSE CLUB franchise by the German toy brand Schleich®
70010000122281.intro: Travel to the Wild River Ranch and experience exciting adventures.
70010000122281.name: HORSE CLUB Ride West

70050000058970.description:
Delve deeper into the eerie lands of The Spiral. 

This additional tale enriches the experience and let you uncover hidden secrets, new perspectives, and unexpected horrors.
70050000058970.name: Little Nightmares III - Second Additional Chapter

70010000121145.description:
How do you stop the two biggest egos of the Seven Seas from fighting? A clash between the Flying Dutchman and King Neptune has unleashed ghostly mayhem all over Bikini Bottom. SpongeBob and Patrick will need all their skills, bravery and - dare I say - wit, to return life to what passes for normal in their undersea home. Join Bikini Bottom's most notorious duo on their ghostliest adventure yet!

Switch seamlessly between SpongeBob and Patrick
Combine SpongeBob and Patrick's unique platforming skills
Master Patrick's brand-new skills like grappling and burrowing
Experience a new ghostly story
Fully voiced by the original cast of the show
Visit iconic locations like Neptune's Palace and Mount Bikini
Battle epic bosses like the Flying Dutchman, King Neptune and Hibernation Sandy
70010000121145.intro: Save Bikini Bottom in this brand-new ghostly adventure!
70010000121145.name: SpongeBob SquarePants: Titans of the Tide

70010000107082.description:
She has one special power: she can see into people's heart and heal emotions through magic!

YOUR DAILY LIFE AS A WITCH-BAKER IN PARIS!
You play as Lunne, who has just arrived in the city! Each day is split into three phases:

-Daytime, where Lunne manages her bakery and serves clients with her team of friends.
-Evening, where Lunne explores Paris, builds relationships, discovers the city's secrets and goes inside her friends' troubled heart.
- Night, where Lunne rests, improves her magic, decorates her bakery and spends time in her cosy atelier.

The story progresses through the days as you earn experience, money, and fame, meet new friends and heal their heart.

A COLORFUL PARIS IN A JOYFUL ADVENTURE!
Once your work day is done, you can visit several districts of Paris to meet with main characters, engage in activities to learn new skills, buy books for new recipes, etc.
From typical streets of famous districts like Montmartre and the Grands Boulevards, to more intimate promenades known only by locals, Paris has many wonders to discover.Each district has its own characters, activities and shops!

A STORY ABOUT EMOTIONS AND VULNERABILITY
For some people, their emotion is locked away so strongly than Lunne needs to go inside their heart to help them. She enters their "Heart Palace", a magical space where emotions and thoughts take shape. Lunne needs to guide the personified Emotion back to the heart.

Inside the Heart Palace, Lunne discovers the person's deepest struggles and finds the key ingredient she needs to make a bread that will heal them!
70010000107082.intro: The Witch's Bakery is a cozy Adventure RPG about a joyful witch who opens her bakery in modern Paris!
70010000107082.name: The Witch's Bakery

70010000107648.description:
Play, explore, and capture moments with Bluey and Bingo in this photo-powered adventure across familiar spots from the show. Snap memories solo or side-by-side with a second player, discover Australian wildlife, and turn in-game moments into real fun for Real Life.

Say Cheese!
Bluey and Bingo have found Dad's old camera (back from when he was cool). Take it with you around Bluey's hometown of Brisbane as you snap photos of the games you play, chase bin chickens and uncover hidden surprises. Each snapshot is saved to your own scrapbook, where you can keep your best moments.

Fun for Everyone
A second player can join in to explore and strike a pose, while the main player leads the adventure behind the camera. Hang out with Muffin, Chloe, Winton and more of Bluey's friends wherever you go, playing with loads of toys and jumping into games from the show, like Shadowlands and Magic Cauldron. 

Play for Real Life
Packed with tips that turn game time into play for Real Life time! Find new ways to play with everyday things in the world around you, turning cushion forts and cardboard boxes into the next big adventure. Kids can explore, play and discover in the game, then take it off the screen and keep the fun going.

Snap, Capture, and Collect
Build your scrapbook one snap at a time. Every photo unlocks stickers inspired by the friends, wildlife, and games you come across. Arrange these stickers, paint them however you like, and dress up Bluey and Bingo with costumes you unlock along the way.

Bluey's Happy Snaps has no in-game purchases and no online play.
70010000107648.intro: Explore Bluey's world like never before!
70010000107648.name: Bluey's Happy Snaps

70010000109109.description:
Step back into Andy’s room with Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and more classic characters in Toy Story: Retro Roundup! This five-game collection features console and handheld versions of four early Toy Story titles, as well as A Bug’s Life. All the games have been upgraded with new features, quality-of-life improvements, and an overflowing toy chest of behind-the-scenes content. Revisit the ‘90s and early 2000s hits you loved and share these titles with a new generation of Toy Story fans. 

Play Toy Story (1995), Toy Story 2: Buzz Lightyear to the Rescue! (1999), Toy Story 2 (1999), Buzz Lightyear of Star Command (2000), Toy Story Racer (2001) and A Bug’s Life (1998). Includes 11 total versions of the games across console and handheld. The games have been enhanced with quality-of-life improvements, including Rewind, Rex’s Cheat Codes, and more. Use Rewind to retry mistakes when you miss a jump across Andy’s shelves or take too many hits from the angry, wind-up robot. Unlock game-specific enhancements like unlimited lives or invincibility with Rex’s Cheat Codes.

Rose is soon swept up in the dark conspiracy that lurks beneath. Will she succeed in saving Paris from devastation?

Customize Rose’s battle style by using a variety of equipment, including weapons spanning seven distinct categories and Relics that trigger powerful effects through both offense and defense.

70010000110875.description:
Experience Tales of Eternia, remastered for the first time ever.

• An Epic Journey with Two Worlds at Stake
Journey to Eternia, a world split into two isolated realms, Inferia and Celestia.
In the remote Inferian village of Rasheans, Reid Hershel and his childhood friend Farah Oersted meet a mysterious girl named Meredy. During their journey to discover Meredy's origins, the group discovers that a collision called the "Great Fall" threatens both Inferia and Celesita.

70010000117094.description:
Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin. 

◆ Cinematic pixel art
What if FINAL FANTASY had continued to push the limits of pixel art? The first FINAL FANTASY to join the HD‑2D lineup, FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE delivers a visually striking experience that feels both nostalgic and new, enhanced by dynamic camera angles and pixelized 3D models that make every moment more dramatic and immersive.

◆ A return to the familiar
A classic RPG adventure unfolds in a world filled with beloved FINAL FANTASY elements—airships, crystals, espers and moogles woven into the fabric of the story, and so much more.

◆ Strategic turn-based battles
Exploit enemy weaknesses to stagger them—breaking their defenses to seize extra turns and gain the upper hand with powerful Resonance attacks in cinematic battles shaped by smart choices.

◆ FINAL FANTASY legends
Bolster your team with Visions, echoes of beloved FINAL FANTASY characters, who fight alongside you with unique skills and abilities for deep party customization.

◆ Hours of side content to discover
The world is full of secrets, including the wandering swordmaster Gilgamesh, a Colosseum with deadly monsters and rewards to match, the Chamber of Arms with formidable foes sealed within legendary weapons, and a showdown with Ultima Weapon.
70010000117094.name: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE

70010000135055.description:
Enemies? Allies? Kill Kill Kill! The more death you bring, the stronger you become! Stat-Raising Strategy RPG is here!

Based on classic grid-based strategy games, this entirely new SRPG features the Peon Exploitation System—a brutal combat mechanic where you mercilessly sacrifice your own allies.
The more misdeeds you commit, the more vicious your army becomes, and the greater your advantage in battle!
Regain the lost power of the Devil, Giga Super Death, who was transformed into a baby, and crush the false god wearing a mask of justice!

■STORY
This is a story of another Earth, different from the one we live on. 
Giga Super Death, the most wicked Devil of all, was just one step away from killing God… 
when suddenly, he was transformed into a helpless baby.

Anticipating such a crisis, he had been working through the night to develop the ""DEMONS' NIGHT FEVER"" resurrection program—and finally, it was time to activate it.
Was it a prank of fate, or inevitable destiny? 
The one ensnared in this suspicious ritual was Killshiro Katanaka, a gloomy young man who despises the world.

Due to their aligned interests, a bizarre pact was formed. 
This is the story of pure EVIL, starring the Devil himself and his newfound disciple, Killshiro.

■Kill, kill, kill both enemies and allies! An unconventional strategic battle!
Exhaust all forms of evil using the Peon Exploitation System which sacrifices your allied Peons during battle! 
Brutal tactics such as Kill Skills and Sacrifices that detonate your underlings with your own hands are the shortest route to victory.

■The more you sin, the stronger you become! Master your base to unleash pure chaos.
Pour in the Perverse Points earned through misdeeds to build your own ultimate evil army! 
Within the limited time, make full use of suspicious Abductions and Pillaging to strengthen your characters to their absolute limits.

■A world that warps with every chapter! Dive into a story where no act of evil is off-limits!
Every time you defeat a chapter's boss, the game's situation completely transforms! 
Experience the full thrill of diverse misdeeds, such as be a monster to defeat Super Rangers, be a witch to crush Magical Girls, or others!
70010000135055.intro: Exhaust all forms of evil by fighting with the brutal Peon Exploitation System!

Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest is an immersive action-adventure game set in the Lake Territories of the beloved Warrior Cats book series.

Embark on a variety of quests to gain favor with your Clan and battle others in turn-based combat to strengthen your cat and grow your legend. Learn new combat moves to take down your rivals. Encounter a wide range of enemies, including mice, squirrels, badgers and more, all leading to epic battles. Forage the land and find materials that can be used to craft items in your den. Travel across iconic territories including ThunderClan’s dense forests, RiverClan’s marshlands, ShadowClan’s dark pine swamps, and WindClan’s open moors. Your adventure will also take you to the famed sacred locations The Moonpool and The Island. Climb trees, pounce through undergrowth, track scents, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the mysteries of StarClan itself.

70010000119008.description:
Following the endings of 9 R.I.P., Misa Isshiki finds herself at a crossroads with navigating romantic life and the consequences of her actions during her second year of high school. New challenges await depending on the route taken… 

Whether it's grappling with the fallout of her death, or navigating a relationship with a supernatural being, Misa must come to terms with her decisions to move forward.

Will she continue along the same path, or take another route entirely?

Key Features

Back from the Dead — 9 R.I.P. has returned from the grave with a sequel! With 9 full routes of love interests from the previous game, there's sure to be a man, demon, or spirit for everyone's tastes.

We're in Heaven — Heavenly Routes are back with a more direct sequel to the previous Heavenly Endings. These stories feature new obstacles to overcome. Make your choices carefully, or they will have consequences for everyone around you… Can you and your love prevail through the challenges of life (and possibly death)? 

Sugar, Spice, and Everything Nice — Need something more on the romantic side to sweep you off your feet? Godly Routes suit fans who crave a happy and sweet ending, serving as epilogues for each Love Interest's Godly Ending in the first game.

Killer Views — Character designer Yuuya kills with breathtaking visuals that once again manage to bring even the dead back to life.
70010000119008.intro: Whether we are alive or dead, he and I still stand on fragile glass. If it shatters, we fall to darkness...
70010000119008.name: 9 R.I.P. sequel

A game based on the wonderful Dog Man comic books by artist Dav Pilkey, also known for Captain Underpants.

Work Together with the Supa Buddies

70010000125589.intro: Join Dog Man and his Supa Buddies for a supa-new adventure! Packed with boss fights, awesome gadgets and up to 10 playable characters, each with unique abilities.

Learn a dozen abilities, each more amazing than the last!

Follow a ragtag group of tech-savvy students led by Rintaro Okabe, whose latest invention accidentally gains the ability to send messages to the past, unleashing the power to alter history itself. As global conspiracies stir and timelines begin to twist, the curtain rises on a future steeped in chaos. Your choices shape the fate of the characters and the world itself! Featuring multiple endings that branch based on your decisions.

・Characters, backgrounds, and pivotal moments have all been updated from scratch. There are twice the amount of still images and 20% more background graphics compared to the original version.
・Character designer huke returns with redesigned outfits and accessories that bring a contemporary flair to the cast while Akihabara has been recreated with stunning realism and depth, including new scenes.

The Cat in the Hat once said, “It’s fun to have fun, but you have to know how.”  

Play with your favorite characters from this exciting Dr. Seuss classic. With easy controls, varying difficulties, and vibrant visuals, this game has something fun for everyone. 70010000096681.description:
A vibrant sci-fi platform adventure game for the Nintendo Switch™, where you help Maxwell the dog explore unfamiliar worlds, make strange new friends and contend with mysterious forces - by jumping, shooting, slicing, shrinking, warping and drilling.

Maxwell’s homeworld is nearing collapse. In a last ditch-effort to find help, he hyperjumps where no dog has gone before. Stranded, he finds himself on the edge of a hostile system - if there’s any hope of return and rescue he’ll need every friend (and every weapon) he can find.

Forced to confront this celestial expanse head on, Maxwell stays strong - determined to keep his head up and lend a helping hand to everyone he meets on his journey. Like all underdogs, the odds are stacked against him, but you can’t keep a good dog down.

Key Features
· Explore jam-packed levels with multiple routes
· Make 50+ friends & collect their friendship cards
· Upgrade your blaster with special abilities
· Find hidden areas and take on a variety of boss battles
· Local couch co-op multiplayer mode
· Bonus prequel content: Chapter Zero
70010000096681.intro: Help Maxwell explore unfamiliar worlds, make strange new friends and contend with mysterious forces.
70010000096681.name: Goodboy Galaxy

70010000131669.description:
The cursed tower rises before you: a colossus whose walls pulse with neon light and echoes of ancient battles. Deep within await the 5 Generals of the Demon King, surrounded by their infernal hordes. They have kidnapped the Saint to offer her as a sacrifice and open a portal that will allow their master to return to this world. Your mission is to plunge into the unknown and rescue her before the Dark Lord’s plans come to pass.

Control your flippers, keep the ball in play, and ascend a tower filled with enemies, secrets, and increasingly intense challenges.

Each room presents a new challenge: destroy enemies, activate powers through cards, and manage your resources to survive. As you progress, you’ll master the physics, discover hidden mechanics and secret routes, and find the keys needed to reach the true ending. Only those who explore carefully, adapt their strategy, and perfect their technique will unravel the secrets of the tower. How far can you go?

- Two game modes: Arcade Mode for quick sessions, and Adventure Mode, where saved items allow for progression.
- Co-Op Mode: Play with the help of a friend. Using the target cursor, they can select cards, defeat enemies, destroy attacks, and collect upgrades.
- Enter 10 challenge stages featuring bosses that will test your precision and skill as you discover their weak points.
- Defeat enemies as you ascend the tower’s 5 floors and uncover all its mysteries.
- More than 15 Power Cards scattered throughout the tower, allowing you to build your own strategy.
- Earn points and climb the online leaderboard.
- Unlock collectible visual filters and customize the game’s appearance.
70010000131669.intro: In Pinballoid Crush, classic pinball evolves into an arcade experience with adventure and strategy elements.
70010000131669.name: Pinballoid Crush

70010000130599.description:
Tarot Tokens is a strategic tile game inspired by the Fools journey through the major arcana of the tarot. Placing Tarot Tokens crafts your journey from four key aspects of the major arcana of the tarot: family, morals, conflict, hope.

Win With Virtues
The aim of Tarot Tokens is to build your three virtues up and keep them nicely balanced by making wise, or seemingly foolish choices, along the way. Run out of any virtue and the journey ends. Reach the end by taking all the steps and reflect on your journey - learn to see pass the numbers and embrace your whole journey.

The Fool
Every game starts with The Fool already placed. Your choices between the Tarot Tokens steers your journey, with the help of the Fools Abilities every few turns. Your journey through the life challenges of placing tokens shape the Fools path that is always different, always yours.

Silence Is Golden
Tarot Tokens has no sound of any kind, no music, no effects, nothing. Enjoy the silence or bring your own noise, much like when using real tarot cards for a reading. Feedback is visual only and there are options to tone it down if you find it a bit much.

Not A Deck Builder
You play with all 22 tokens of the major arcana, every game. A randomly selected number of tokens are offered to you each turn, except The Fool who is used only once at the start of every game. All tokens interact with some other tokens on the board. Each token has its own unique effect with most generating virtues in addition to other token interactions. 

Follow Your Path
Play your favourite token as often as you want, if it is available that turn. Or play highly tactically to gain maximum virtue and be really efficient, although you might just be missing out. Every token is always unlocked and randomly chosen every turn - no token fixing or token reading goes on (even though it might feel that way if your journey feels off).

A Hex On You!
Tarot Tokens uses a hex grid in shameless violation of the four sided card format of the tarot. The essence of the tarot is faithfully preserved in a hex shape with on-demand help explaining virtues, adjacency information, and a brief description of the significance of that tarot token in the context of the Fools journey. Hex grids are still over rated though!
70010000130599.name: Tarot Tokens

70010000111796.description:
Grab the mic—or your smartphone—and get ready to shine! Let’s Sing 2027 transforms any occasion into a musical celebration with a brand-new playlist of chart-toppers and classics from around the world. Sing solo for high scores or team up with friends and family for unforgettable duets and group performances.  

Featuring songs with their original music videos, adjustable vocal guide settings, and easy-to-use smartphone and mic support, Let’s Sing 2027 makes singing accessible, fun, and endlessly replayable. Whether you’re hosting a party or chasing your best score, it’s your turn to take center stage!

This year, step into Soundtown in an all-new Party mode—a lively musical adventure where you’ll face off against DJ Hush and bring the beat back to the city. With improved visuals, fresh avatars, and customizable rewards, every performance feels like a moment in the spotlight.

Featuring 35 chart-topping songs there's something for everyone—from modern hits to timeless classics.

70010000131565.description:
Experience a milestone in video game history in a completely reimagined version! Authorized by original developer Matthew Smith, this reboot of the 1983 classic combines the distinctive and challenging gameplay of MANIC MINER with modern graphics, improved controls, newly arranged music, and extensive historical bonus content.

Step back into the role of miner Willy and take on 20 legendary levels filled with deadly creatures, clever jumps, and tricky obstacles. Collect all the items before your oxygen runs out and master one of the most challenging platformers of all time.

Climb the global MANIC MINER online leaderboard and become number one in one of the toughest classics in gaming history!

This re-release offers two modes: Enjoy the original pixel art look, or discover all the levels in atmospheric HD graphics with elaborate parallax scrolling, dynamic lighting effects, and lovingly designed backgrounds.

Thanks to modernized controls, MANIC MINER plays more precisely and smoothly than ever before, without losing any of the original’s high standards.

The classic has also been reimagined musically: The works by Johann Strauss and Edvard Grieg, which were already featured in the original, have been rearranged to give the adventure a contemporary sound.

In addition, the collection includes a comprehensive interactive history that documents the exciting story behind the creation of MANIC MINER from the early 1980s to the present day.

Features
•    Faithful, pixel-perfect recreation of the classic
•    All 20 original levels included in full
•    Choice between classic pixel graphics and a modern reinterpretation
•    Beautiful new backgrounds with parallax scrolling and atmospheric effects
•    Completely revamped controls for modern platforms
•    Global online leaderboard
•    Re-arranged soundtrack featuring classic works by Johann Strauss and Edvard Grieg
•    Extensive interactive history of the creation of Manic Miner
•    Authorized by original developer Matthew Smith

Jump, collect, survive - will you rise to the challenge?
70010000131565.intro:
The legendary platforming classic is back!
Jump, collect, survive - Rediscover one of the greatest and most challenging video game classics of all time!
70010000131565.name: MANIC MINER

Put on your detective hat in Cluedo Jr. as you search for clues, cross off suspects, and solve the case before anyone else! Play on your own or in local multiplayer for up to 4 players on one console. Create your own adorable avatar and make it truly yours with fun customization options and unlock new looks and cosmetic rewards just by playing matches.

Easy to learn and packed with exciting moments every round, it’s perfect for family game nights, friendly competition, and big smiles from start to finish!

3 CLASSIC GAMES IN ONE: Play Monopoly Jr., Cluedo Jr., and The Game of Life Jr.

FUN FOR EVERYONE: Kid-friendly rules that are easy to learn and play fast.

 LOCAL MULTIPLAYER PARTY: Play together with up to 4 players on one console.

70010000100155.description:
What is Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure?
A single-player, tilt-based platformer game for everyone. A heartwarming physics-based adventure for all ages. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

Why do we need Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure?
Marupoyo is a charismatic, simple alternative to complex heroes, featuring a clean art style perfect for all ages. It offers the ideal mix of relaxing vibes and fun challenges. It's a unique game for everyone to enjoy alone or with the family.

What kind of players can enjoy the game?
The game is designed for everyone, having an easy  accessibility in the controls (just need to tilt the controller to play!) and with only one action: brake. Also, the Family Mode adds elements to avoid players dying, allowing players that like cozy games to play and have fun. However, the gamer mode brings more speed, deathly elements and adds lots of challenges to the game, such as beating the clock, getting the badge for not losing lives or the Pro player badge for not using brakes.

Story Summary
Marupoyo is a unique chick born so round he can’t walk — he can only roll! Though initially mocked for his clumsiness, he becomes the village’s only hope when a massive tornado scatters his family across the kingdom.

Guided by the Queen of Nature, Marupoyo rolls through forests, icy mountains, sandy deserts and volcanoes to stop an exiled Alchemist whose experiments are destroying the world. Along the way, he rescues his siblings and proves that his unique way of moving is actually a superpower - always rolling forward! Without fear, he will restore peace and become the kingdom's greatest hero.

Gameplay Elements
★ Physics Movements: tilt the board to move game elements.
★ Walls and floors: Colliding, Movable, walk-through and Bumpy.
★ Adversaries: Path Followers that may bump or defeat you.
★ Dangers: Cliffs, Holes, Water, Lava and Corruption will be hazardous.
★ Natural Hurdles: such as Water streams, Ice, Grass and Bumpy Mushrooms.
★ Family Mode: Cotton Clouds will cover most of the dangers in the levels.
★ Gamer Mode: Normal gameplay with all the challenges available.

Collectables and Challenges
★ Rescue all the family members during your trip. Once saved, you can visit them in your hometown and improve bonds with corn.
★ Win against the clock in Time Attack challenges in every level and earn extra Corn prizes (and a badge to be proud of!)
★ Collect all the Corn within a level and win an extra Corn prize (and again, medals for you!)
★ Find all the music tracks hidden in the game.

Family game mode
★ This mode is a bit slower, takes deathly stuff and adds clouds to avoid falling, reducing frustration.
★ Clouds will be bouncy, to keep it fun.
★ This mode eliminates the visual fear of younger players. (I don’t want to fall into lava)

Accessibility
★ Motion Sick toggle, to quit floor movement on screen and reduce dizziness. 
★ Sound volume split with Music, VO and Sound Effects.
70010000100155.intro: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Control Marupoyo as he rolls through levels, avoiding obstacles and rescuing his lost siblings.
70010000100155.name: Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure

*This is the Nintendo Switch™ version. There is also a Nintendo Switch™ 2 version of this game. Please select the version you require carefully. 

In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle.

Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

[About the Game]
Befriend a Medley of Monsters
- There's a whole host of monsters to befriend, including many familiar favorites from across the DRAGON QUEST series.
- While each monster has its own traits and attributes, they can also learn a variety of talents, allowing you to fine tune your party to match your playstyle.
- Combine two monsters via synthesis to create an even stronger creature, maybe even one you've never seen before.
- Create a party of your favorite monsters that fights exactly the way you want. The possibilities are mind-boggling!

A World Full of Wonder
- With the game's unique visual style, you never quite know what lies beyond the curve of the horizon.
- Each step forward reveals more about your surroundings, where new discoveries and fresh surprises await.

Monsters by Your Side
- Your monsters will follow you as you explore the world so you can enjoy every adventure together.
- You can take any monster along with you, regardless of its type or size.

Stay Competitive with Extra Content

- With a variety of modes to enjoy, from serious tournaments to friendly matches, there's plenty to try.

70010000092409.name: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World

70010000098134.description:
Leap into a lost world of mechanical wonders and embark on a hopping adventure with the adorable Labi! Use a wide range of jumps and moves to traverse this colorful cartoon world, meet squishy creatures and clumsy robots, and uncover its hidden secrets.

GAMEPLAY

Labi is all about powerful, precise jumps!

Installing a thruster module instead of a mobility module by mistake gave Labi the shortest yet most powerful legs of any robot. With those mighty legs, Labi can perform a Leg Launch and blast off like a cannonball, Stomp enemies with tremendous force, or spring off walls.

And it gets even better! Once Labi finds the Warp Ball, you can instantly teleport to wherever it lands. To overcome obstacles and solve puzzles, plan your route carefully and combine Running, Stomping, Dashing, and Double Jumping to find the best way forward. When danger strikes, Dash like a ninja and rely on your quick reflexes to dodge whatever comes your way.

GOALS

The core directive of Labi’s program: seek FREEDOM!

Collect Batteries scattered throughout each level. Some lie in plain sight along the main path, while others require a little extra exploration. At the end of each level, you will receive Gems based on the number of Batteries you collected. Gather enough Gems to unlock new areas.

Collect every Battery in a level to unlock its Time Trial. Complete the challenge to earn the level’s final Gem—a worthy prize for serious challengers!

FEATURES

Every being, organic or synthetic, has value—even robots. Cute ones, at least!

An enemy one moment may become your friend the next. Despite their intimidating appearance, enemies do not mind Labi bouncing on their heads. Manipulate, provoke, or even protect them, then use their abilities to complete levels in ways you never imagined.

STORY

An imaginary yet strangely realistic post-apocalyptic world.

Where did all these robots come from? Who created them? And why do those seemingly pointless assembly lines continue running forever?

Explore a fantastical world of giant fruit and adorable robots while uncovering a heartfelt story about humanity and identity. Journey through colorful, vibrant environments, interact with an intriguing cast of characters, and gradually piece together the history of this world. Help our little hero discover what truly matters, reveal everything that has been lost, and befriend a whole cast of totally huggable characters!
70010000098134.intro: Leap, warp, and uncover the secrets of a lost mechanical world with the adorable Labi!
70010000098134.name: Fall Up

70010000122697.description:
Join Noah, Mio and their friends as they traverse epic landscapes, battle ferocious creatures and fight to break the never-ending cycle of violence that binds their homelands.

The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition adds the mythical new Hero, Shimmer, who can join you on your adventure! Shimmer is a speedy Attacker who can unleash devastating rapid-fire combos on her foes. She also wields the power of Foresight to see the future!

Defeat as many enemies as you can in a defensive battle mode, exclusive to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition. The more enemies you defeat, the more you’ll fill a gauge that you can use to strengthen your forces. Enhance your abilities, gain additional allies, but choose wisely – you’ll need to prepare well to defeat the almighty foe awaiting you at the end!
70010000122697.intro: A tale of life, tying past to future

70010000114003.description:
*This is the Nintendo Switch™ version. There is also a Nintendo Switch™ 2 version of this game. Please select the version you require carefully.

Romancing SaGa 3, the acclaimed JRPG first released in Japan in 1995, returns in a full 3D remake. Whether you're a longtime SaGa fan or a newcomer, this reimagining offers a fresh take on a classic adventure.

■Story
Every 300 years, Morastrum, the Star of Death, rises, dooming all born beneath it except the mysterious Child of Destiny. Nearly twenty years after its last appearance, an insurrection in Loanne uncovers a far greater threat: the Four Sinistrals seek to reopen the gates to the Abyss. Eight heroes bound by fate must unite to save the world.

■Characters
Choose from eight protagonists, each with a unique story, and recruit over twenty allies to your party

■Graphics
Inspired by the original pixel art and Tomomi Kobayashi's illustrations, the remake features character designs by Yoshiro Ambe and fully realized 3D environments.

■Freeform Scenario System
Your choices shape the adventure, from the stories you pursue to the order in which you challenge the Sinistrals, creating a unique experience every playthrough.

■Battle and Character Power Systems
Classic SaGa features such as Glimmer and Formation return alongside a new timeline-based battle system and United Attacks for deeper tactical combat.

■Difficulty
Choose from Casual, Normal, or Classic difficulty to tailor the challenge to your playstyle.

■Music and Voices
Original composer Kenji Ito supervised newly arranged music, with players able to switch between original and arranged tracks.
70010000114003.intro: A remake of Romancing SaGa 3! Choose from eight heroes in this turn-based RPG.
70010000114003.name: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United
